s: believers are commanded to worship (and pay the poor-due)
q: Establish worship, and pay the poor-due;

s: believers are commanded to prayer (as a means of seeking help)
q: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer.

s: believers are commanded to steadfastness (in seeking help)
q: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer.

s: believers are characterized by faith
q: And if they believe in the like of that which ye believe, then are they rightly guided.

s: believers are staunch in love for Allah

q: But Allah chooseth for His mercy whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

q: Neither those who disbelieve among the people of the Scripture nor the idolaters love that there should be sent down unto you any good thing from your Lord.

s: people of the Scripture recognize the truth (as they recognize their sons)
q: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture recognise (this revelation) as they recognise their sons.

s: people of the Scripture conceal the truth (knowingly, in part)
q: But lo! a party of them knowingly conceal the truth.

s: Jews are not pleased with Muhammad (until he follows their creed)

s: Abraham is a leader (for mankind)
q: Lo! I have appointed thee a leader for mankind.

s: Allah is able to do all things
q: Knowest thou not that Allah is Able to do all things?

s: Abraham is chosen in the world
q: Verily We chose him in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.

s: Abraham is among the righteous (in the Hereafter)
q: Verily We chose him in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.

s: Abraham surrenders to Allah (as Lord of the Worlds)

s: the House is a place of worship (for those who go around, meditate, bow and prostrate)
q: And We imposed a duty upon Abraham and Ishmael, (saying): Purify My house for those who go around and those who meditate therein and those who bow down and prostrate themselves (in worship).

s: the Inviolable Place of Worship is a qiblah (for believers in prayer)
q: So turn thy face toward the Inviolable Place of Worship, and ye (O Muslims), wheresoever ye may be, turn your faces (when ye pray) toward it

s: Allah owns the sovereignty (of the heavens and the earth)
q: Knowest thou not that it is Allah unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth;

s: the heavens and the earth belong to Allah
q: Nay, but whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth is His.

s: the Hereafter contains the righteous
q: Verily We chose him in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.

s: the Scripture contains the guidance
q: Lo! Those who hide the proofs and the guidance which We revealed, after We had made it clear to mankind in the Scripture:

s: the Scripture is read by people of the Scripture (with the right reading)
q: Those unto whom We have given the Scripture, who read it with the right reading, those believe in it.

s: the true religion is chosen for Children of Israel (by Allah)
q: Lo! Allah hath chosen for you the (true) religion;

q: He who chooseth disbelief instead of faith, verily he hath gone astray from a plain road.

s: disbelief is a choice against faith
q: He who chooseth disbelief instead of faith, verily he hath gone astray from a plain road.

s: guidance is from Allah (the guidance of Allah is Guidance)
